source.place: Tags 01N2, 01MY and 01MZ; the corresponding clause of the normalized fraction argument.

proof.text: Refine local homogeneous-fraction neighborhoods for s and t to a common standard open W. Restrict all three sections to W and use the pointwise product hypothesis to prove the product fraction equation with numerator ac and denominator bd. Apply the normalized comparison rule to the three fractions. The normalized images of b and d are units, proved by applying the same rule to the fractions 1/b and 1/d. Cancel their product in the localization, then use restriction compatibility to return to the original point.

theorem scalarExtension_twist_multiplication
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (r : Proj ℬ ⟶ Proj 𝒜)
    (θ : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback r).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ≅ twist ℬ j)
    (hθ : IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison ψ r θ) :
    ∀ (i j : ℤ) (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens)
      (s : Γ(twist 𝒜 i, U)) (t : Γ(twist 𝒜 j, U))
      (v : Γ(twist 𝒜 (i + j), U)),
      (∀ x : U, (v.1 x : Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) =
        (s.1 x : Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) * t.1 x) →
      ∀ x : r ⁻¹ᵁ U,
        ((scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ (i + j) U v).1 x :
          Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) =
        ((scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ i U s).1 x :
          Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) *
        (scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ j U t).1 x
